name: modboard
description: One board for every agent and every person. You decide what's on it: tasks, handoffs, CI, any command's output. Open it with /board

band.title: Band blocks
band.description: Blocks on the one line above the prompt, in order, comma-separated: summary, board (a button that opens the pane), usage, compact, model, effort, clock, context, or your own from Your own blocks.

pane.title: Pane blocks
pane.description: Blocks in the /board pane, in order, comma-separated: tasks, taskfile (the project's task.md, behind a button), compact (context bar and a compact button), usage, model, effort, clock, context, agents, or your own from Your own blocks.

blocks.title: Your own blocks
blocks.description: Blocks that show a shell command's first line of output, refreshed every 30 seconds, as JSON: {"ci": "gh run list -L1 --json conclusion -q '.[0].conclusion'"}. Then name them in Band blocks or Pane blocks.

models.title: Models to switch between
models.description: The models the model block steps through, in order, as /model takes them.

efforts.title: Effort levels to switch between
efforts.description: The levels the effort block steps through, in order, as /effort takes them.
